h: Chioma reportedly gushes over her sister's glamorous look at Zlatan Ibile's wedding
p: Davido's wife Chioma has reportedly shared her admiration for her sister's styling at Zlatan Ibile's star-studded wedding. The event continues to dominate celebrity chatter, with guests' outfits and moments still being widely discussed online.
more: Chioma is said to have praised the look in a post shared after the ceremony.
Davido's own moments at the wedding have also drawn plenty of online reaction.
